_meta.source: NIST PQC round-3 submission package (FrodoKEM-Round3.zip), FrodoKEM/FrodoKEM-20200930/KAT/PQCkemKAT_*.rsp (AES and _shake variants)
_meta.note: first 3 tests per parameter set/variant; full official files have 100 tests each. The KAT randomness is the Bassham AES-256-CTR DRBG seeded per count (see tests/common/drbg.rs); keygen consumes one 2*SS+16-byte draw, encapsulation one MU-byte draw.
